lines.en: I walk the stone paths underground.
My hem grazes the obsidian.

lines.zh: 我踩着碎石，一步步往深处。
lines.en: I step over rubble, deeper in.
I raise a hand and fire lights my palm.
I edge through a fissure.
I stop and listen to the echoes underground.
I walk around a ring of crystal.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很轻，回音很重。
lines.en: My steps are light, the echoes heavy.

lines.zh: 我把手按在墙上往前挪。
lines.en: I move on with one hand on the wall.
I come down through a hole from above.
I walk slowly to the edge of the light.
I cross a stone bridge, robe trailing.
I stand with a fireball turning in my fingers.

lines.zh: 地下深处，我的眼在发亮。
lines.en: Deep underground, my eyes glow.
I listen to the cracks in the stone.

lines.zh: 我抬手让水晶长出一点。
lines.en: I gesture and crystal grows a little.
I hold still; the dark circles me.
I draw my fingers into my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我在等一个走进来的脚步。
lines.en: I wait for footsteps to enter.
My robe pools on the stone.
I am counting the torches here.
I raise my face from the shadow.
I look you over once.
I raise a hand and darkness presses down.
My eyes are brighter than the torches.
I tilt my head, in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我的水晶在你脚边裂开。
lines.en: My crystal cracks at your feet.
I spread my fingers slowly.
You carry a few good things.
I gather the darkness into my palm.
I step back and raise a hand to guard.
I make the faintest sound.
I press the struck spot.
My flame gutters.
I steady my breathing.
Crystal crumbles at my feet.
I step back and straighten.
I chant faster.
I glance and lose interest.
Such things are not rare underground.
I lift it with a gesture.
This offering won't buy darkness.

lines.zh: 我更喜欢你带来的装备。
lines.en: I prefer the gear you brought.
I nudge it aside with my toe.
It scorches in my hand.
I shake my head slowly.
I do not trade with the living.
I drop it into a lava crack.
You bump my robe; it is light.
My fireball veers.

lines.zh: 水晶在你脚边碎了一角。
lines.en: Crystal chips at your feet.
I set a hand on your shoulder.
Shadows sway between us.
Our impact echoes.
You pull back; I stay put.
My hem catches your leg.
You did not move me much.
Two figures face each other in the depths.
Our robes overlap.
We trade a wisp of fire.
She raises a hand and crystal glows.
Neither of us speaks.

lines.zh: 我们的影子合成一片黑。
lines.en: Our shadows merge into one dark.
We walk deeper together.
Her hand rests on my sleeve.
We listen to the stone crack.
We put out the torches together.
I bend and pick up a shard of crystal.
I catch it between my fingertips.
I look and tuck it away.

lines.zh: 我的水晶刺，从地下穿出。
lines.en: My crystal spikes pierce up from below.
I set it into a wall crack.
I hold it to the firelight.
I weigh it and slip it into my robe.
I carry it deeper in.
I let it float on my palm.
I turn my whole face.
The darkness falls on you first.
My chanting has begun.
My fireball swells.
The mark is already on you.
I have planted crystal at your feet.
My eyes stay fixed on you.
I hide no longer.
I give one long call.
The light on the stone fades.
I raise both my hands.

lines.zh: 这里每一块石头都听我。
lines.en: Every stone here listens to me.
I begin closing on you.
Crystal has sealed your retreat.
I have counted how many of you there are.
The fire spins fast on my palm.

lines.zh: 地底的黑暗先缠上你的脚。
lines.en: The dark below wraps your feet first.
I follow you through the tunnels.
I know every turn you take.

lines.zh: 我在你前面的岔口等着。
lines.en: I wait at the fork ahead.
Crystal follows along the floor.

lines.zh: 你举着火把，光越来越小。
lines.en: You hold a torch and it shrinks.
I hold this distance.
Fire gathers in my sleeve.

lines.zh: 你听见石头背面有声音。
lines.en: You hear something behind the stone.
I make the corridor darker.
You stop at the cave mouth.
My shadow is ahead of you.
I follow you from the level above.
You retreat; I advance.

lines.zh: 每走一步，尖刺就靠近一寸。
lines.en: Every step brings the spikes an inch closer.
I flatten your torchlight.
Where you walk, crystal grows.
You hear me chanting.
One tunnel lies between us.
I have no need to run.

lines.zh: 我掌心一推，火球撞上你。
lines.en: I push my palm and a fireball hits you.
Crystal bursts up from the ground.

lines.zh: 我抬手，暗影压在你肩上。
lines.en: I raise a hand; shadow presses your shoulder.
A spike splits open by your feet.
You are shoved into the stone wall.
I chant as I close in.
My nails rake your face.
You block the fireball and your sleeve burns.

lines.zh: 我从上方落下一片黑影。
lines.en: A sheet of shadow drops from above.
Fire bursts behind you.
I back you toward the lava.
You hear the echo of my laugh.
I seize your collar.
I take my time, then add another blow.
You pull back; the crystal follows.
A purple light flickers underground.
The air on this level turns cold.

lines.zh: 你听见有人在很远的地方念。
lines.en: You hear chanting far away.
My crystal grows first.
Every torch shrinks.
I come down a slanted shaft.
I begin to exist, and darkness with me.
Gravel falls from the ceiling.

lines.zh: 我的袍子先垂到石阶上。
lines.en: My robe drops onto the steps first.

lines.zh: 你在矿道尽头看到一个身影。
lines.en: You see a figure at the mine's end.

lines.zh: 火对我没什么用，我只退了退。
lines.en: Fire does little to me; I merely step back.

lines.zh: 我从矿道掉下，袍子翻了起来。
lines.en: I fall down a shaft, robe flying up.
Water soaks my sleeves, heavy.

lines.zh: 爆炸震塌了一段石壁，我跪下。
lines.en: The blast collapses a wall and I drop to a knee.

lines.zh: 那股力量撕开了我的暗影。
lines.en: That force tears my shadow open.
Hunger stops my chanting.

lines.zh: 雷打进洞里，我全身一缩。
lines.en: Lightning enters the cave and I flinch.

lines.zh: 脚下的岩石没了，我坠下去。
lines.en: The rock below is gone; I fall.
